project.title: Launch of Integrated Eco-Tourism Experience Platform
project.objective: Design and launch a digital-first eco-tourism experience platform that bundles curated trips, services, and add-ons to grow revenue and improve customer satisfaction.
deliverables: Validated eco-tourism product portfolio and pricing model
End-to-end customer journey and experience blueprint
MVP requirements and feature specification for the platform
Financial model with revenue and cost projections
Launch KPI dashboard definition and tracking plan
constraints: MVP scope must be deliverable within 90 days by downstream teams
All products must comply with local tourism and environmental regulations
Budget for initial launch marketing is capped and pre-approved
Platform must support at least two languages at launch
Experiences must align with conservation and community-benefit principles
Pricing must be competitive with existing eco-tourism offers

risks.risk: Insufficient validation of customer demand for new eco-tourism bundles.
risks.mitigation: Run rapid customer interviews, A/B test landing pages, and pilot limited offers before full rollout.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with tourism or environmental regulations in target regions.
risks.mitigation: Involve legal and compliance review in product approval checklist and maintain a vetted partner list.

risks.risk: Overly large MVP scope causing delays and budget overruns.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict prioritisation using MoSCoW, lock MVP scope early, and track scope changes via tickets.

risks.risk: Misalignment between revenue targets and sustainable community impact.
risks.mitigation: Define impact KPIs alongside financial KPIs and include community feedback in product evaluation.

risks.risk: Fragmented customer experience across booking, payment, and on-site services.
risks.mitigation: Create a single customer journey blueprint and require all features to map to defined journey stages.

themes.why_relevant: Keeps the initial platform launch focused, feasible, and aligned with time and budget constraints.
Ensures experiences are attractive, sustainable, and differentiated from generic tourism offers.
Aligns digital flows and on-site service to deliver a seamless, high-satisfaction experience.
Directly impacts profitability, partner incentives, and perceived value for customers.
Tour operators, communities, and internal teams must be coordinated for a smooth launch.
Provides data to iterate on products, marketing, and operations after launch.

backlog.task: Define target customer segments and priority eco-tourism markets for MVP
definition_of_done: Customer segments documented with personas and key needs
Priority regions and market rationale captured in strategy doc
Stakeholders review and sign off on target segments

backlog.task: Curate initial eco-tourism product bundles and itineraries
definition_of_done: At least 8-10 bundles defined with clear inclusions and exclusions
Each bundle mapped to sustainability and community criteria
Pricing ranges and seasonality constraints documented

backlog.task: Design end-to-end customer journey for booking and on-site experience
definition_of_done: Customer journey map created from discovery to post-trip feedback
Pain points and delight moments identified and prioritised
Journey map validated with at least two internal stakeholders

backlog.task: Define MVP feature set and user stories for the platform
definition_of_done: MVP feature list prioritised using MoSCoW or similar framework
User stories written with acceptance criteria for each feature
Dependencies and assumptions captured in the requirements doc

backlog.task: Build financial model and revenue projections for the first 12 months
definition_of_done: Revenue, cost, and margin assumptions documented
3 scenarios (base, optimistic, conservative) modelled
Model reviewed with finance and product stakeholders

backlog.task: Define eco-tourism partner selection and compliance criteria
definition_of_done: Checklist of environmental, safety, and service standards created
Partner onboarding process documented
Compliance review step integrated into product approval flow

backlog.task: Draft go-to-market plan and distribution channel strategy
definition_of_done: Key channels (direct, agencies, platforms) identified and prioritised
Launch messaging and value proposition drafted
High-level campaign calendar aligned with budget constraints

backlog.task: Define KPI framework and dashboard requirements for launch
definition_of_done: Core KPIs for acquisition, conversion, satisfaction, and impact defined
Data sources and owners identified for each KPI
Dashboard requirements documented for analytics implementation

backlog.task: Align platform strategy and budget with executive expectations
definition_of_done: Executive summary of strategy and financials prepared
Budget envelope and key milestones agreed
Risks and mitigation plan endorsed by leadership

backlog.task: Create service standards and on-site experience guidelines for partners
definition_of_done: Service standards documented for pre-trip, on-trip, and post-trip phases
Guidelines shared with at least 3 pilot partners
Feedback from partners incorporated into final version

backlog.task: Prioritise backlog and prepare handover package for delivery teams
definition_of_done: Backlog items ranked and tagged for MVP vs later releases
Key artifacts linked and organised in a single index
Handover walkthrough session scheduled with delivery leads

backlog.task: Define risk register and governance cadence for the launch phase
definition_of_done: Top project risks captured with owners and mitigations
Decision-making and escalation paths documented
Regular review cadence agreed with core team

artifacts.title: Partner Selection and Sustainability Criteria
artifacts.used_for: Defines standards for selecting and onboarding eco-tourism partners and experiences.

artifacts.title: Customer Journey and Experience Blueprint
artifacts.used_for: Maps the end-to-end customer journey and key experience requirements for the platform.

artifacts.title: MVP Backlog and Prioritisation Matrix
artifacts.used_for: Lists user stories, priorities, and dependencies for the MVP scope.

artifacts.title: Service Standards for On-Site Eco-Tourism Experiences
artifacts.used_for: Provides partners with clear expectations for service quality and customer care.

artifacts.title: Go-To-Market and Channel Plan
artifacts.used_for: Outlines launch messaging, campaigns, and distribution channel tactics.

artifacts.title: KPI Framework and Launch Dashboard Spec
artifacts.used_for: Defines KPIs, data sources, and dashboard requirements for tracking performance.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on vision, target segments, and MVP scope for the platform.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message from the chief executive officer requesting alignment on strategy and MVP.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm primary customer segments and priority regions for the MVP launch.
Approve the initial MVP feature set documented in the strategy artifact.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate eco-tourism bundles, partner criteria, and service standards.
threads_plan.trigger: Tourism product manager shares first draft of curated bundles and partner criteria.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which curated bundles will be included in the MVP catalog.
Approve partner selection and sustainability criteria for pilot partners.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock pricing approach, financial assumptions, and budget envelope.
threads_plan.trigger: Chief executive officer posts preliminary financial model and asks for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on pricing strategy and key financial assumptions for the first year.
Confirm budget envelope for MVP build and launch marketing.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prioritise backlog, define KPIs, and prepare handover to delivery teams.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager shares updated backlog and KPI framework for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Freeze MVP backlog priorities and confirm handover readiness.
Approve KPI set and dashboard requirements for launch tracking.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on go-to-market narrative, channels, and launch milestones.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager posts draft go-to-market and channel plan for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm launch date window and key external launch milestones.
Agree on primary acquisition channels for the MVP launch.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each participant posts yesterday-today-blockers in a short update.
Twice-weekly MVP scope and risk check-in thread led by a product manager.
Weekly KPI and financial assumptions review summarising latest insights and changes.
Pre-milestone go/no-go review before locking any external launch date.
Post-decision recap messages summarising outcomes, owners, and next steps for each major decision.
